mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals monetary easing, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary and fiscal stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 signals an acute economic contraction, prompting policy responses that generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates consumer resilience and triggers positive equity returns as the market prices in continued stimulus over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises and UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior month indicates easing inflation pressures, reducing the probability of monetary tightening and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines by at least 0.5 points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) falls below 140,000 thousand, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering expectations of fiscal and monetary support that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 140000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0) signals an acute economic contraction, prompting aggressive policy responses that generate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL < 240), a decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) from the prior quarter signals an economic slowdown, triggering stimulus that produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines from the prior quarter and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL < 240.
